Based on the provided tables, the most relevant ones for finding US postal addresses would be `CalendarItem` (which might contain event locations) and `Attachment` or `AttachmentFile` (which might contain files with address information). Here's the SQL query to search for US postal addresses in these tables:

```sql
SELECT body FROM CalendarItem WHERE body REGEXP '(?i)\b(?:p\.?\s*o\.?\s*box|post\s+office\s+box|[0-9]+\s+(?:ave\.?|avenue|st\.?|street|rd\.?|road|blvd\.?|boulevard|dr\.?|drive|ln\.?|lane|ct\.?|court|pl\.?|place|way|pkwy\.?|parkway|cir\.?|circle|ter\.?|terrace|hwy\.?|highway|trl\.?|trail|sq\.?|square|pike|loop|run|walk|path|byp\.?|bypass|(?:n|s|e|w|ne|nw|se|sw)\b))\b' UNION ALL
SELECT data FROM Attachment WHERE data REGEXP '(?i)\b(?:p\.?\s*o\.?\s*box|post\s+office\s+box|[0-9]+\s+(?:ave\.?|avenue|st\.?|street|rd\.?|road|blvd\.?|boulevard|dr\.?|drive|ln\.?|lane|ct\.?|court|pl\.?|place|way|pkwy\.?|parkway|cir\.?|circle|ter\.?|terrace|hwy\.?|highway|trl\.?|trail|sq\.?|square|pike|loop|run|walk|path|byp\.?|bypass|(?:n|s|e|w|ne|nw|se|sw)\b))\b' UNION ALL
SELECT data FROM AttachmentFile WHERE data REGEXP '(?i)\b(?:p\.?\s*o\.?\s*box|post\s+office\s+box|[0-9]+\s+(?:ave\.?|avenue|st\.?|street|rd\.?|road|blvd\.?|boulevard|dr\.?|drive|ln\.?|lane|ct\.?|court|pl\.?|place|way|pkwy\.?|parkway|cir\.?|circle|ter\.?|terrace|hwy\.?|highway|trl\.?|trail|sq\.?|square|pike|loop|run|walk|path|byp\.?|bypass|(?:n|s|e|w|ne|nw|se|sw)\b))\b';
```

This query searches for patterns that match US postal addresses in the `body` column of `CalendarItem` and the `data` columns of `Attachment` and `AttachmentFile` tables. The pattern includes PO Boxes, street numbers with street names and suffixes, and cardinal directions.
